extraction.name: EuroSAT
extraction.description: EuroSAT is a novel dataset based on Sentinel-2 satellite images for land use and land cover classification. It covers 13 spectral bands and consists of 10 classes with 27,000 labeled and geo-referenced image patches of 64x64 pixels, distributed across European cities in over 34 countries.
extraction.creator: Patrick Helber, Benjamin Bischke, Andreas Dengel, Damian Borth (TU Kaiserslautern and German Research Center for Artificial Intelligence (DFKI))
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Satellite images were downloaded from the Sentinel-2A satellite via Amazon S3, covering European cities distributed in over 34 countries. Images with low cloud levels were selected. Image patches of 64x64 pixels were extracted and manually checked multiple times, with mislabeled images and images full of snow or ice removed.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Physical data collection, Manual Human Curator
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Multi-spectral satellite images from the Sentinel-2A satellite, downloaded via Amazon S3, covering cities in the European Urban Atlas across 34 European countries.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Bands with a lower spatial resolution have been upsampled to 10 meters per pixel using cubic-spline interpolation.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Image patches of 64x64 pixels were extracted from satellite images. Images with low cloud levels were selected. All 27,000 images were manually checked multiple times; mislabeled images and images full of snow or ice were removed. The dataset has not received atmospheric correction.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Image patches were labeled according to 10 land use and land cover classes based on the European Urban Atlas mapping guide. All 27,000 images were manually checked multiple times and mislabeled images were corrected or removed.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset distribution is influenced by the number of represented cities per country in the European Urban Atlas. Images were extracted all over the year to maximize variance, but the dataset covers only European cities.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset has not received atmospheric correction, which can result in images with a color cast. The spatial resolution is 10 meters per pixel, limiting the distinguishability of fine-grained classes. The dataset covers only European cities and is based on Sentinel-2A imagery.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset is intended for training, testing, and benchmarking land use and land cover classification models. It can also be used for land use and land cover change detection and assistance in improving geographical maps.

name.evidence: We present a novel dataset based on Sentinel-2 satellite images covering 13 spectral bands and consisting out of 10 classes with in total 27,000 labeled and geo-referenced images.

description.evidence: The proposed EuroSAT dataset consists of 27,000 labeled images with 10 different land use and land cover classes. A significant difference to previous datasets is that the presented satellite image dataset is multi-spectral covering 13 spectral bands in the visible, near infrared and short wave infrared part of the spectrum.
